# libxsm3

libxsm3 provides the Xbox Security Method 3 exchange used by Xbox 360 controllers.

This copy was modified by 3D Printed Controller Systems on November 4, 2026, for the Console Compatibility mod. See the root `MODIFICATIONS.md` for the changes.
